lens.title: Lens Analytics
lens.summary: An internal platform using generative AI to turn client data and reports into actionable insights.
lens.decision: Full-stack product development and AI-layer integration through AWS Bedrock, collaborating with product teams and non-technical stakeholders.
lens.result: Reporting processes that took hours now generate insights in seconds.

requalify.title: Requalify
requalify.summary: Full-stack career reskilling platform: it analyzes the résumé with GPT-4 and generates, in real time, a career roadmap with courses, checkpoints and learning resources.
requalify.decision: Built as a team. Layered Java REST API with Spring Boot, authentication with Spring Security and JWT, PDF résumé upload and processing on the backend, and GPT-4 integration to generate the roadmaps, consumed in real time by a React Native app.
requalify.result: Presented to and approved by an academic panel at FIAP.

mottu.title: Motorcycle Rental API
mottu.summary: RESTful API to manage Mottu's fleet: users, motorcycles and rentals, tracking each contract's status and the fleet's availability.
mottu.decision: ASP.NET Core Web API with Entity Framework Core and Oracle Database, DTOs separating the domain from the API contracts, HATEOAS to navigate resources through response links, pagination for large volumes and interactive Swagger/OpenAPI docs.

bank.title: Bank System API
bank.summary: A banking API supporting account management, deposits, withdrawals, queries and PIX transfers protected by business rules.
bank.decision: Domain modeling, validation and transactional operations.
